author: Brandjuh
name: Enigmic
short: An original murder-mystery deduction puzzle game.
description: Enigmic is an original murder-mystery deduction puzzle. Players place suspects and a victim on a crime-scene grid so that every row and column holds exactly one character and every clue is satisfied, then unmask the murderer - the only suspect alone with the victim in the same room. Includes eight solver-validated bundled cases, a daily case, hints powered by a constraint solver, statistics, leaderboards, and admin-importable custom cases.
install_msg: Thanks for installing Enigmic! Load it with `[p]load enigmic`, then start your first case with `[p]enigmic start`. Administrators can configure the game with `[p]enigmicset`.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs together with puzzle progress (active games), completion statistics, and daily-case records. It does not store message content, email addresses, IP addresses, or any data from outside Discord. Users can request deletion of their data through Red's standard data deletion commands, which removes their active games, statistics, daily records, and leaderboard entries.
